_doc: Expiring allowlist of KNOWN high/critical PROD-dependency advisories, consumed by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs (wired into .github/workflows/security.yml). Mirrors the cargo-audit RUSTSEC_IGNORES discipline in the same workflow. A high/critical in ANY package NOT listed here FAILS the gate. Past `expires`, every entry stops suppressing and the gate re-fails — forcing the dependency-upgrade sprint. Keyed by the top-level npm package name as reported by `npm audit --omit=dev --json`.
_expiryNote: Re-extended (PROPOSAL, 2026-07-03) 2026-07-31 -> 2026-10-31 for the npm ws/viem wallet debt ONLY. Rationale: the documented exit (wagmi-3, dependabot #181) is UPSTREAM-BLOCKED — @rainbow-me/rainbowkit 2.2.x peers wagmi ^2.9.0 and no RainbowKit release supports wagmi 3 (rainbow-me/rainbowkit discussion #2575, no timeline), so the debt cannot be retired by 2026-07-31. It stays confined to the read-only browser wallet surface (no signer/broadcast/funds). The cargo-audit RUSTSEC allowlist (security.yml ALLOWLIST_EXPIRES) is intentionally LEFT at 2026-07-31 so its fail-honest cliff still forces the operator's per-id re-justification (3 weak ids flagged in #256). The new date + risk-acceptance REQUIRE operator confirmation before merge (proposal PR, no auto-merge). Lockfile-fixed entries (next 15.5.20, hono 4.12.25+, http-proxy-middleware 3.0.7, form-data 4.0.6) remain REMOVED so future highs there block again.

allow.ws: Only remaining vulnerable copies are ws@8.18.0 exact-pinned by nested viem@2.23.2 under @walletconnect/utils@2.21.0 / @reown/appkit* — frozen by @wagmi/connectors@6.2.0 exact pins. Everything reachable within semver was bumped to ws 8.21.0 on 2026-07-03 (api-server direct ws, ethers 6.17.0, socket.io/engine.io chain, top-level viem 2.54.2). Plan: resolved by the wagmi-3 upgrade (dependabot #181).
